questions.subject: Programming skills · Counting loops
questions.text: A counting loop uses 2, 4, 6, and 8. What is its step?
questions.explanation: Each successive value increases by two.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Counting loops
questions.text: A loop includes every integer from 3 through 7. How many iterations run?

questions.subject: Programming skills · Counting loops
questions.text: Which three choices describe a numeric counting range?
answers: Starting value, stopping rule, and step
questions.explanation: These choices determine the counter values and when counting stops.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Counting loops
questions.text: A loop starts at 10 and subtracts 2 while the value is at least 4. Which values are used?
questions.explanation: Four is included by the at-least-four stopping rule; two is not.
